baseline.transform: Static relative import prefix ./ replaced with ../../../dist/; implementation bytes otherwise preserved. Baseline and candidate share current dependencies and fixture geometry, isolating physics implementation differences.

scope: Localized physical wheel-orientation synchronization and reset correction. Before/after use the same current helper dependencies and declared fixture geometry. No target-GPU, real keyboard, city-route or general curb-recovery claim.

limits: This correction does not claim that 90 km/h curb strikes are recoverable. Both severe upsets remain.
The 20 km/h wheel/rail fixture demonstrates correct contact geometry, not a general handling or safety improvement.
The default-regen approach starts at 20 km/h but reaches the curb more slowly. The passive regen=0 fixture is declared test setup only; production default is unchanged.
Energy channels omit tyre deformation and exact discontinuous ray-spring work. They are diagnostics, not a complete vehicle impact model.
